verses.original: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū yō·wm tə·rū·‘āh yih·yeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: On the first day of the seventh month you are to hold a sacred assembly and you must not do any regular work . . . This will be a day for you to sound the trumpets
verses.literalPt: SEMELHANTEMENTE, tereis santa convocação no sétimo mês, no primeiro dia do mês; nenhum trabalho servil fareis; será para vós dia de sonido de trombetas.

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ‘ō·lāh lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh par ben- bā·qār ’e·ḥāḏ ’a·yil ’e·ḥāḏ kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh šiḇ·‘āh tə·mî·mim
verses.literal: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD you are to present a burnt offering of one young . . . bull one ram and seven male lambs a year old . . . all unblemished
verses.literalPt: Então por holocausto, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, oferecereis um novilho, um carneiro e sete cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito.

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵ֥י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֖ים לָאָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯām sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm lap·pār šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm lā·’ā·yil
verses.literal: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil three-tenths of an ephah . . . with the bull two-tenths of an ephah . . . with the ram
verses.literalPt: E pela sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, três décimas para o novilho, e duas décimas para o carneiro,

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘iś·śā·rō·wn ’e·ḥāḏ lak·ke·ḇeś hā·’e·ḥāḏ lə·šiḇ·‘aṯ hak·kə·ḇā·śîm
verses.literal: and a tenth of an ephah . . . with each of the seven . . . male lambs
verses.literalPt: E uma décima para cada um dos sete cordeiros.

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm ’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Include one male goat . . . as a sin offering to make atonement for you
verses.literalPt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, para fazer expiação por vós;

verses.original: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mil·lə·ḇaḏ ‘ō·laṯ ha·ḥō·ḏeš ū·min·ḥā·ṯāh wə·‘ō·laṯ hat·tā·mîḏ ū·min·ḥā·ṯāh wə·nis·kê·hem kə·miš·pā·ṭām lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: These are in addition to the monthly and daily . . . burnt offerings with their prescribed grain offerings . . . and drink offerings They are a pleasing aroma a food offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Além do holocausto do mês, e a sua oferta de alimentos, e o holocausto contínuo, e a sua oferta de alimentos, com as suas libações, segundo o seu estatuto, em cheiro suave, oferta queimada ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇe·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î haz·zeh miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·‘in·nî·ṯem ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: On the tenth day of this seventh month you are to hold a sacred assembly and you shall humble yourselves you must not do any work
verses.literalPt: E no dia dez deste sétimo mês tereis santa convocação, e afligireis as vossas almas; nenhum trabalho fareis.

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ פַּ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ‘ō·lāh Yah·weh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ par ben- bā·qār ’e·ḥāḏ ’a·yil ’e·ḥāḏ kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh šiḇ·‘āh tə·mî·mim yih·yū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Present as a pleasing aroma to the LORD a burnt offering of one young . . . bull one ram and seven male lambs a year old . . . all unblemished
verses.literalPt: Mas por holocausto, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, oferecereis um novilho, um carneiro e sete cordeiros de um ano; eles serão sem defeito.

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯām sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm lap·pār šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm lā·’a·yil hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil three-tenths of an ephah . . . with the bull two-tenths of an ephah . . . with the ram . . .
verses.literalPt: E, pela sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, três décimas para o novilho, duas décimas para o carneiro,

verses.original: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iś·śā·rō·wn ‘iś·śā·rō·wn lak·ke·ḇeś hā·’e·ḥāḏ lə·šiḇ·‘aṯ hak·kə·ḇā·śîm
verses.literal: and a tenth of an ephah . . . with each of the seven . . . lambs
verses.literalPt: E uma décima para cada um dos sete cordeiros;

verses.original: שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַכִּפֻּרִים֙ וְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm ’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ mil·lə·ḇaḏ ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ hak·kip·pu·rîm wə·‘ō·laṯ hat·tā·mîḏ ū·min·ḥā·ṯāh wə·nis·kê·hem
verses.literal: Include one male goat . . . for a sin offering in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offerings
verses.literalPt: Um bode para expiação do pecado, além da expiação do pecado pelas propiciações, e do holocausto contínuo, e da sua oferta de alimentos com as suas libações.

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם חַ֛ג לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū wə·ḥag·gō·ṯem ḥaḡ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month you are to hold a sacred assembly you must not do any regular work . . . and you shall observe a feast to the LORD for seven days
verses.literalPt: Semelhantemente, aos quinze dias deste sétimo mês tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis; mas sete dias celebrareis festa ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ‘ō·lāh ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh pā·rîm bə·nê- ḇā·qār šə·lō·šāh ‘ā·śār ’ê·lim šə·nā·yim kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār tə·mî·mim yih·yū
verses.literal: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD you are to present a food offering a burnt offering of thirteen . . . young . . . bulls two rams and fourteen . . . male lambs a year old . . . all unblemished
verses.literalPt: E, por holocausto em oferta queimada, de cheiro suave ao SENHOR, oferecereis treze novilhos, dois carneiros e catorze cordeiros de um ano; todos eles sem defeito.

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָאַ֣יִל הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לִשְׁנֵ֖י הָאֵילִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯām sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm lap·pār hā·’e·ḥāḏ liš·lō·šāh ‘ā·śār pā·rîm šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm lā·’a·yil hā·’e·ḥāḏ liš·nê hā·’ê·lim
verses.literal: along with the grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with oil with each of the thirteen . . . . . . bulls two-tenths of an ephah . . . with each of the two . . . rams
verses.literalPt: E, pela sua oferta de alimentos de flor de farinha misturada com azeite, três décimas para cada um dos treze novilhos, duas décimas para cada carneiro, entre os dois carneiros;

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂרׄוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כְּבָשִֽׂים׃

verses.literal: and a tenth of an ephah . . . with each of the fourteen . . . . . . lambs
verses.literalPt: E uma décima para cada um dos catorze cordeiros;

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm ’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ mil·lə·ḇaḏ ‘ō·laṯ hat·tā·mîḏ min·ḥā·ṯāh wə·nis·kāh
verses.literal: Include one male goat . . . as a sin offering in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering
verses.literalPt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, a sua oferta de alimentos e a sua libação;

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šê·nî pā·rîm bə·nê- ḇā·qār šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ’ê·lim šə·nā·yim kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār tə·mî·mim
verses.literal: On the second day you are to present twelve . . . young bulls two rams and fourteen . . . male lambs . . . . . . . . . a year old all unblemished
verses.literalPt: Depois, no segundo dia, doze novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

verses.literal: along with the grain and drink offerings . . . for the bulls rams and lambs according to the number prescribed
verses.literalPt: E a sua oferta de alimentos e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ס

verses.literal: Include one male goat . . . as a sin offering in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering
verses.literalPt: E um bode para expiação do pecado, além do holocausto contínuo, da sua oferta de alimentos e das suas libações.

verses.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי־ עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî pā·rîm ‘aš·tê- ‘ā·śār ’ê·lim šə·nā·yim kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār tə·mî·mim
verses.literal: On the third day you are to present eleven . . . bulls two rams and fourteen . . . male lambs a year old . . . all unblemished
verses.literalPt: E, no terceiro dia, onze novilhos, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

verses.literal: along with the grain and drink offerings . . . for the bulls rams and lambs according to the number prescribed
verses.literalPt: E as suas ofertas de alimentos, e as suas libações para os novilhos, para os carneiros e para os cordeiros, conforme o seu número, segundo o estatuto;

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

verses.literal: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly you must not do any regular work . . .
verses.literalPt: No oitavo dia tereis dia de solenidade; nenhum trabalho servil fareis;

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֥ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לְבַ֨ד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּלְמִנְחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶ֖ם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃

verses.literal: You are to present these offerings to the LORD at your appointed times in addition to your vow and freewill offerings whether burnt offerings grain offerings drink offerings or peace offerings
verses.literalPt: Estas coisas fareis ao SENHOR nas vossas solenidades além dos vossos votos, e das vossas ofertas voluntárias, com os vossos holocaustos, e com as vossas ofertas de alimentos, e com as vossas libações, e com as vossas ofertas pacíficas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: So Moses . . . spoke all this to the Israelites . . . just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.
